about: Where a recipe card on the page says more than its JSON-LD (#119, #120). Data only, read by both apps; rationale in docs/decisions.md. version: raise it on every edit (a copy fetched later would be used only if newer). cards: ingredient lists on any site (recipe plugins); sites: by host without www., each with its own cards, tried before those. A card: list, the element holding the ingredients; item, one ingredient; heading, a group's name (used only if it is h1-h6, ends in a colon or is wholly bold); title, an element inside the list to ignore; amount, elements inside an item left out when matching it (the card writes 'cups' where JSON-LD writes 'c.'); trustHeading: true, whatever heading finds is a group's name, whatever element it is (#439). A card only adds the group headings JSON-LD (or a microdata recipe, #437) drops, and only when its items line up one-to-one with the recipe's lines: the same count, each item's letters and digits found in its line. stepNoise: phrases that start noise at the end of the last step (a note on when the recipe was published); from the phrase on is dropped. wholeStepNoise: phrases (any case) that make the whole last step noise (a pointer to a video); it is dropped, after stepNoise, unless it is the only step (#440). stepPhotos: photos the page shows beside each step and JSON-LD leaves out (#438): step, one step; photo, one of its photos (an img or an element holding one); number, the photo's attribute giving its number; marker, the step text's element holding a number; used only when every step's markers are exactly its photos' numbers, numbered 1, 2, 3... through the recipe, and the steps line up with JSON-LD's. Rules go by the host of the link the cook shared, so a site that moved is listed under its old host and its new one. Selectors: a tag, .class, #id, [attr], [attr=v], [attr^=v], [attr*=v], compounded, in comma lists; no combinators. Values are case-sensitive.
